_comment: Cyber RAG corpus config. Merged over built-in defaults; env vars (FH_RAG_DB, FH_RAG_EMBED_MODEL, FH_RAG_TOP_K, ...) win. Leave embed_model empty for lexical-only BM25 retrieval (no credentials needed); set it to an embedding model id (e.g. text-embedding-3-small) to make retrieval hybrid, then run `fh rag embed` to backfill vectors for what is already stored. See financeharness/rag/README.md.
